summary: Master Change Management for Projects with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools to lead successful change initiatives.
lede: Change management for projects connects stakeholder impacts, organizational readiness, resistance signals, adoption activities, and benefits reporting within the project’s schedules, risks, governance, and change control. This course aligns practical application with the PMI PMBOK Guide, ISO 21502:2020 guidance, the Prosci ADKAR Model, and structured review through a Change Control Board. You will practise using stakeholder engagement assessments, readiness diagnostics, RACI matrices, communication plans, adoption dashboards, and integrated change roadmaps. Microsoft Excel templates, a Power BI demonstration dashboard, and conceptual and operational coverage of AI-assisted sentiment analysis support hands-on planning, monitoring, and reporting.
audienceIntro: This project change management course is designed for professionals who coordinate delivery, adoption, governance, and benefits across project environments. It suits experienced practitioners who need to connect project controls with measurable workforce and stakeholder transition.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software and viewing web-based collaboration materials. The course teaches advanced concepts at an operational application level, with selected AI-assisted analysis covered at a conceptual awareness level. You will configure templates and interpret dashboards rather than develop software or machine-learning models.
